gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histopathological and molecular confirmation of newly diagnosed GBM using IDH mutation testing

candidate_evidence.quote: Experimental: Resection, GammaTile and Stupp Protocol
Surgical tumor resection, GammaTile radiation therapy implantation, Stupp protocol (EBRT and Temozolamide)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: GammaTile and Stupp in Newly Diagnosed GBM

role_evidence.quote: receive daily temozolomide (TMZ, 75mg/m2) and 20 fractions external beam radiation (EBRT)

arms: Experimental: Resection, GammaTile and Stupp Protocol

source_quote.quote: Known to be IDH mutated glioma by prior biopsy.
Patients with either methylated or unmethylated MGMT promoter status are included

coder_notes: Single-arm device trial (GammaTile Cs-131 brachytherapy, a device) added to the Stupp protocol; only drug is temozolomide as backbone, so no pharmacological candidate. 5-ALA/fluorescein is only mentioned in eligibility as pre-surgery guidance, not a registered intervention, so not listed. MGMT: both statuses are included, so coded as non-selecting (exploratory_correlative); tissue adequacy for MGMT testing is an entry requirement, adjudicator may prefer eligibility.
